verdict.rationale: Linear ships an official MCP server: its own docs are at linear.app/docs/mcp, the integrations directory lists Cursor and Claude connecting to it, and the changelog adds Okta-managed access to it. The pack shows the server exists and is documented, but contains no setup steps or list of exposed tools. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP server's tools and setup in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting via it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
